items.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [asks about Carole Kromer and Diane Gregg

ctx.x: Oh, I hear from them all the time. I’ll play the record for you.
[asks about Carole Kromer and Diane Gregg who encouraged Liston to come to the Women’s’ Jazz Festival in Kansas City in 1979.]
[does not remember their names.] Two women were anxious for her to come to Kansas City.
